verdict.rationale: Justworks documents creating PTO policies under Time Off > Policies > + Add policy inside the Justworks Payroll account. Setup fields include policy type, policy cycle, balance structure and timecard sync, and company holidays recur automatically each year. Accrual configuration is only implied by 'balance structure', approval workflows are never mentioned, and the automatic flow of PTO into payroll is only suggested by 'timecard sync'. Missing for 10: explicit accrual-rate configuration, PTO request/approval workflow, documented automatic application of PTO to payroll runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
